title: 2D Aiming
controls: Move mouse to aim; left-click to shoot. Aim near each target's center for better precision.

title: 2D Shooting
controls: WASD or arrows move; mouse aims; left-click fires. Cover blocks movement and shots.

title: 2D Collect & Dodge
controls: WASD or arrows move; combine keys for diagonals. Collect coins and avoid moving hazards.

title: 2D Lane Driving
controls: Left/right arrows or A/D steer. Collect coins across four lanes; release keys to hold your lateral position.

title: 2D Circuit Driving
controls: WASD or arrows accelerate in screen directions. Cross checkpoint lines in order; stay within the fences.

title: 2D Platforming
controls: A/D or left/right arrows move; Space, W or up arrow jumps; hold Shift to sprint. Reach flags and avoid pits and spikes.

title: 2D Crafting
controls: Left-click picks up or places stacks and takes output; right-click splits or places one item. The Recipe Book can autofill ingredients.

title: 3D Aiming
controls: Move the mouse to aim. Left-click to shoot the active target.

title: 3D Shooting
controls: WASD moves. Move the mouse to aim. Left-click fires. E reloads. Space jumps.

title: 3D Road Driving
controls: W / Up accelerates. S / Down brakes. A / D or Left / Right steers. Cross the checkpoints in order.

title: 3D Lane Driving
controls: A / D or Left / Right steers. The car moves forward automatically. Collect the road coins.

title: 3D Spear Duel
controls: WASD moves. Move the mouse to look. Hold left mouse for 0.4s, then release to thrust. Space dodges.

title: 3D Sword Duel
controls: WASD moves. Move the mouse to look. Center the crosshair on a nearby opponent and left-click to slash. Space dodges.

title: 3D Melee Combat
controls: WASD moves relative to the camera. Move the mouse to orbit. Left-click slashes. Space dodges.

title: 3D Navigation
controls: WASD moves. Move the mouse to look around. Reach the flag, then find its next position.

title: 3D Chasing
controls: WASD moves relative to the camera. Move the mouse to orbit the camera. Chase and reach the moving target.
